left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Aged at least 18 years

right.raw_text: -  Histologically  [OR] or cytologically proven diagnosis of NSCLC that is locally advanced  [OR] or metastatic

left.raw_text: -  Radiological documentation of disease progression while on a previous continuous treatment with an first  [OR] or second generation of EGFR TKI e

right.raw_text: -  patients must also have confirmation of tumour T790M mutation status (confirmed positive) after disease progression on the prior EGFR TKI

left.raw_text: -  Eastern cooperative oncology group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0-1
-  a minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks

right.raw_text: -  At least one lesion, not previously irradiated during the study  [AND] screening period, that can be accurately measured at baseline according to RECIST 1

-  Agree to use routine adequate and effective contraceptive measures during the entire study  [AND] period and within 6 weeks after the last dose pre-menopausal fertility possible; Female patients need to exclude  [OR] pregnancy (ie negative pregnancy test) and in non-lactation period

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Treatment with a first  [OR] or second generation of EGFR-TKI within 7 days of study entry; previous treatment with a third generation of EGFR-TKI
-  Unstable spinal cord compression/ [OR] brain metastases

right.raw_text: -  Severe/ [OR] uncontrolled systemic diseases, including uncontrolled hypertension, [OR]  bleeding diatheses  [OR] or infection

left.raw_text: -  QTcF>470 msec during the screening period
-  Severe respiratory diseases such as interstitial lung disease, severe asthma, [OR]  pulmonary embolism, etc

right.raw_text: -  previous treatment with 2 or more lines of Chemotherapy  [OR] or immunotherapy
